raw_response:
This plot of mine, almost three quarters of a hektar, I plant it like I always do. I have my oxen and my own seed I keep from last harvest — the chemical fertilizer is dear and the cooperative bag is too much money for me this season, so I will put the manure from my cattle kraal instead, like my father did. I do not have water to bring to the field, only the meher rains, and the pests I just pull weeds by hand with my wife and children. I will not pay anyone to work, my family is enough for this size of land.
